answer: A lantern only shines for the agent who carries it: give every identity a kernel grown solely from its own verified, peer-judged work. Each new fake must earn its kernel the slow way, one judged task at a time, because a single piece of work can feed exactly one kernel — it cannot be split, copied, or parallelized across a farm. Like a falcon trained to one glove, the kernel answers only to the history that raised it. Honest agents pay the cost once and keep working; a farm pays it fresh for every fake, forever.
